name: Browse the updated Queenshop product catalogue
description: Verifies the product catalogue displays the added clothing types, prices, and selectable motifs.
steps: Select the Daster category and verify the Daster Harian Motif price is Rp35.000
Review the size and motif options
expected: The catalogue displays the added Daster, Kulot, Gamis, Setelan, and Atasan products with the supplied prices and variant choices.

name: Apply the three-piece kulot promotion
description: Verifies three kulot pieces receive the Rp100.000 package price.
steps: Open Celana Kulot Motif and add it to the cart
Verify the line subtotal and cart subtotal
expected: The kulot subtotal is Rp100.000 for 3 pieces and the cart indicates that the package promotion is active.

name: Prevent checkout for the setelan without a listed price
description: Verifies a product whose price is absent from the supplied poster cannot be added to the cart.
steps: Review its price status and purchase control
expected: The setelan shows Harga belum tersedia and its purchase button is disabled.

name: Complete checkout with the updated product prices
description: Verifies the updated catalog pricing carries through checkout and the payment simulation disclosure remains visible.
steps: Add Daster Harian Motif to the cart
Enter a valid recipient name, phone, address, city, and postal code
Select QRIS and place the order
expected: The order confirmation displays the updated price total and states that the payment is simulated.

name: Use search and cart on a mobile screen
description: Verifies that the new product catalogue remains searchable and usable on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the home page at mobile viewport width
Open the cart and increase quantity
expected: Search results, add-to-cart, and quantity controls remain usable on the mobile layout.
